text.name: NF_MAX_ASSISTANT_WORKERS_long
text.text: How many workers can work in parallel at maximum?

text.name: NF_trafficLimit_long
text.text: How many AI traffic vehicles drive simultaneously on the map? (1-8). Waypoints and spawn points are set in the 'Waypoints' tab.

text.name: NF_trafficTrailerSize_long
text.text: Implements for traffic vehicles. 0 = None | 1 = Small | 2 = Medium | 3 = All (plows, cultivators, mowers, tedders, rakes, seed drills)

text.name: NF_engeMap_long
text.text: For narrow maps and cramped dealer areas: neighbours only use small and medium tractors (up to 12 t) with light implements (tedders, rakes, up to 3 t), and field work always gets the smallest vehicle group - short rigs fit short spawn places. Large tractors, wheel loaders and telehandlers stay out. Off = as before, everything allowed.

text.name: input_NF_MANAGE_WAYPOINTS
text.text: NachbarFelder: Show waypoints one by one

text.name: NF_wpMapShow_long
text.text: Show waypoints as markers on the ingame map (category: MISCELLANEOUS)

text.name: NF_wpType_long
text.text: Cycle category: Normal (20-60s) | Short (5-20s) | Long (2-5 min) | Spawn point. Better create new spawn points with 'Set spawn point here' - older points have no reliable direction.

text.name: NF_wpAddHere_long
text.text: Places a normal waypoint at your position (in a vehicle: at the vehicle's position). Keep at least 10 m from other points.

text.name: NF_wpAddSpawnHere_long
text.text: New neighbour vehicles start here. Sit in a tractor facing the exit direction (on foot your view direction counts). About 4 m width must be clear from 3 m in front to 14 m behind the point. Drive away afterwards - while your vehicle stands there, the point counts as occupied.

text.name: NF_wpNone
text.text: No waypoints - use 'Set waypoint here' or 'Set spawn point here' below

text.name: NF_wpCatTractorS_long
text.text: Spawn small tractors (up to ~100 HP) as traffic vehicles

text.name: NF_wpCatTractorM_long
text.text: Spawn medium tractors (~100-200 HP) as traffic vehicles

text.name: NF_wpCatTractorL_long
text.text: Spawn large tractors (200+ HP) as traffic vehicles

text.name: NF_wpCatLoader_long
text.text: Spawn wheel loaders as traffic vehicles (only if navmesh-capable)

text.name: NF_wpCatTeleLoader_long
text.text: Spawn telescopic handlers as traffic vehicles (only if navmesh-capable)

text.name: input_NF_ORDER_FIELD
text.text: NachbarFelder: Hire contractor for this field

text.name: NF_auftragHier_long
text.text: The neighbour helpers plow or cultivate the field you are standing at (up to 25 m from the field edge) - your own field as well. Own fields: permission 'Hire assistant' required. Unowned fields: admin only. Fields of other farms and fields with a standing crop are refused.

text.name: NF_auftrag_ok
text.text: Order accepted - field %s will be %s. The helper starts at the dealer.

text.name: NF_auftrag_keinePosition
text.text: Order not possible - your position is unknown.

text.name: NF_auftrag_keinFeld
text.text: No field nearby - stand in the field or at most 25 m from its edge.

text.name: NF_auftrag_fremd
text.text: Field %s belongs to another farm - no order possible.

text.name: NF_auftrag_keinRecht
text.text: Field %s: you lack the permission 'Hire assistant' for your farm.

text.name: NF_auftrag_nurAdmin
text.text: Field %s has no owner - orders for unowned fields are admin only.

text.name: NF_auftrag_belegt
text.text: A neighbour helper is already working on field %s.

text.name: NF_auftrag_gesperrt
text.text: Field %s is locked for the neighbour helpers (console: nachbarFelderSperre).

text.name: NF_auftrag_vertrag
text.text: An accepted contract is running on field %s.

text.name: NF_auftrag_bebaut
text.text: Field %s: building or fence inside the field - too risky for the helper.

text.name: NF_auftrag_weide
text.text: Field %s lies inside a fenced pasture.

text.name: NF_auftrag_klein
text.text: Field %s is smaller than 0.3 ha - too small for the helper.

text.name: NF_auftrag_gruenland
text.text: Field %s is grassland - the contractor only plows and cultivates.

text.name: NF_auftrag_frucht
text.text: There is a crop on field %s (%s) - harvest first, then hire.

text.name: NF_auftrag_bearbeitet
text.text: Field %s is already worked - nothing to do.

text.name: NF_auftrag_unklar
text.text: The state of field %s is unclear - no order.

text.name: NF_auftrag_arbeitAus
text.text: Plowing and cultivating are disabled in the settings.

text.name: NF_auftrag_voll
text.text: All neighbour helpers are busy - try again later.

text.name: NF_auftrag_keineFarm
text.text: No helper farm available - see the server log.txt.

text.name: NF_auftrag_inaktiv
text.text: NachbarFelder is switched off in the settings.

text.name: NF_auftrag_platz
text.text: Field %s: the dealer spot is occupied - try again in a minute.

text.name: NF_auftrag_fehler
text.text: Order could not be started - see the server log.txt.
